<!--
  THE EXPERIMENT FIGURE. Sits between the character-count slides and
  fig-tokens.png, and its only job is to make the measurement legible before
  the numbers land: what, exactly, was asked for in each condition.

  TOP: three separate asks, one per output format. The agent emits the finished
  artifact and that is the end of the chain.
  BOTTOM (click 1): the same agent, the same three outputs, but what the agent
  writes is one .qmd and Quarto does the rest.

  REGISTRATION. The agent box is at the SAME x (170..350) in both halves, and
  the writes-arrow is byte-identical to the three arrows above it. The only
  thing that differs is what lands on the other end. That is the whole picture.
  Don't recentre either half independently — the top block ending at x=578 while
  the bottom runs to x=912 is the point, not a layout bug.

  THE THREE OUTPUT ICONS ARE FONT AWESOME WEBFONT GLYPHS, not paths:
  `Font Awesome 6 Free` at weight 900 for the solid file icons (\f1c1 pdf,
  \f1c2 word) and `Font Awesome 6 Brands` at 400 for html5 (\f13b). The font is
  already on the page because the three character-count slides use the `fa`
  shortcode; if those ever go, this figure turns to tofu, which is why every
  icon also carries a text label beside it.

  NB: do not write a bare `fa` shortcode anywhere in this comment. Quarto's
  shortcode pass scans raw HTML blocks, comments included, and an argument-less
  one crashes fontawesome.lua at `stringify(args[1])`.

  THE .qmd IS QUARTO'S OWN MARK, drawn as a path rather than a glyph. The
  iconify extension renders `simple-icons:quarto` as a Web Component, which
  cannot live inside an SVG, so the path is copied in at 24x24 and scaled 1.667
  to 40 units. It is the same artwork the `quarto` shortcode paints on the
  character-count slide.

  COLORS are the cost slides' ramp, NOT the content/format chips: Quarto blue,
  amber PDF, red HTML, Word blue. Same order, same colours, so this slide and
  the character counts agree. The mark wears Quarto's brand #74aadb; the letters
  beside it wear the darker twin, because #74aadb is 2.5:1 on white. The
  entanglement figure's yellow/teal vocabulary is deliberately absent — this
  slide is about what was measured, not about what is fused to what.

  Arrows follow the deck's one convention: 2.5 stroke, 80 units, 2-unit gap off
  the source box, refX=5.5 on the marker. Marker id is unique document-wide
  (`ahExp`) because reveal display:none's non-current slides.
-->

```{=html}
<svg viewBox="0 75 1085 520" width="100%" style="max-height:80vh;"
     xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     font-family="'Fira Sans Condensed', Tahoma, sans-serif">

  <defs>
    <marker id="ahExp" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="5.5" refY="3"
            orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L7,3 L0,6 z" fill="#2e4057"/></marker>

    <!-- The agent. Same dashed rounded rect as the entanglement figure: the
         dash is the stochastic step, and it is identical in both halves
         because the agent is not what changes. -->
    <g id="agentBox">
      <rect x="170" y="-28" width="180" height="56" rx="6"
            fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"
            stroke-dasharray="7 5"/>
      <text x="260" y="0" font-size="24" text-anchor="middle"
            dominant-baseline="central" fill="#2e4057">LLM agent</text>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <!-- ============ TOP: ask for the artifact ============ -->

  <text x="170" y="110" font-size="30" font-weight="600" fill="#2e4057">Ask for the artifact</text>

  <!-- PDF -->
  <g transform="translate(0 170)">
    <use href="#agentBox"/>
    <path d="M 352 0 L 432 0" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"
          marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
    <text x="468" y="0" font-size="46" text-anchor="middle"
          dominant-baseline="central" fill="#A77400"
          font-family="'Font Awesome 6 Free'" font-weight="900">&#xf1c1;</text>
    <text x="500" y="0" font-size="26" dominant-baseline="central"
          fill="#A77400" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.pdf</text>
  </g>

  <!-- HTML -->
  <g transform="translate(0 250)">
    <use href="#agentBox"/>
    <path d="M 352 0 L 432 0" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"
          marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
    <text x="468" y="0" font-size="46" text-anchor="middle"
          dominant-baseline="central" fill="#d1495b"
          font-family="'Font Awesome 6 Brands'" font-weight="400">&#xf13b;</text>
    <text x="500" y="0" font-size="26" dominant-baseline="central"
          fill="#d1495b" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.html</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Word -->
  <g transform="translate(0 330)">
    <use href="#agentBox"/>
    <path d="M 352 0 L 432 0" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"
          marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
    <text x="468" y="0" font-size="46" text-anchor="middle"
          dominant-baseline="central" fill="#2B579A"
          font-family="'Font Awesome 6 Free'" font-weight="900">&#xf1c2;</text>
    <text x="500" y="0" font-size="26" dominant-baseline="central"
          fill="#2B579A" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.docx</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ BOTTOM: ask for the .qmd ============ -->

  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1">

    <line x1="170" y1="388" x2="912" y2="388" stroke="#c9ced6" stroke-width="2"/>

    <text x="170" y="442" font-size="30" font-weight="600" fill="#2e4057">Ask for the .qmd</text>

    <g transform="translate(0 500)">
      <use href="#agentBox"/>

      <path d="M 352 0 L 432 0" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"
            marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
      <text x="392" y="-16" font-size="21" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e4057">writes</text>

      <!-- The one .qmd, wearing Quarto's own mark. 24x24 artwork scaled 1.667
           to 40 units and hung on the row's centreline: translate puts its top
           left at (462, -20), so it is centred on x=482 like the glyphs above.

           It sits in the entanglement figure's box — same white fill, same navy
           2.5 stroke, same rx=6 — because it is the same object: a FILE, not a
           format, which is why the container is neutral rather than teal. The
           box is also what stops the source from reading as a fourth output
           icon in a row of three. Its right edge at 602 leaves the deck's
           2-unit gap before the render line starts at 604; the left edge at 446
           clears the incoming arrowhead, which lands ~436. -->
      <rect x="446" y="-32" width="156" height="64" rx="6"
            fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <g transform="translate(462 -20) scale(1.66667)">
        <path fill="#74aadb" d="M12.65 12.854V24c6.042-.325 10.923-5.105 11.33-11.125H12.65Zm-1.504 0H.02c.427 5.94 5.166 10.699 11.105 11.105V12.854Zm1.505-1.505H24C23.675 5.247 18.753.325 12.65 0Zm-1.505 0V0C5.106.427.326 5.308 0 11.35Z"/>
      </g>
      <text x="526" y="0" font-size="26" dominant-baseline="central"
            fill="#3d7fb5" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.qmd</text>

      <!-- render, then the fan. The straight run 604..682 is the render step;
           the three 80-unit arrows off the junction are the three outputs, and
           they are the same arrow the top half uses three times. One source,
           three artifacts, and the agent wrote none of them. -->
      <path d="M 604 0 L 682 0" fill="none" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <text x="643" y="-16" font-size="21" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e4057">render</text>

      <!-- Fan spread is 64 units, up from 50: at 50 the three glyphs read as a
           single block of icons rather than three separate outputs, which is
           the opposite of what the fan is for. The corner radius stays 12, so
           each elbow runs to (spread - 12) before the quad. The viewBox height
           grew to 520 to hold the bottom row — the .docx glyph now centres at
           y=564 and reaches ~587 against a floor of 595. Change the spread and
           that floor has to be rechecked. -->
      <path d="M 682 0 L 682 -52 Q 682 -64 694 -64 L 762 -64" fill="none"
            stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
      <path d="M 682 0 L 762 0" fill="none"
            stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
      <path d="M 682 0 L 682 52 Q 682 64 694 64 L 762 64" fill="none"
            stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>

      <!-- Same three icons, same three colors, same order as above. -->
      <text x="800" y="-64" font-size="46" text-anchor="middle"
            dominant-baseline="central" fill="#A77400"
            font-family="'Font Awesome 6 Free'" font-weight="900">&#xf1c1;</text>
      <text x="834" y="-64" font-size="26" dominant-baseline="central"
            fill="#A77400" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.pdf</text>

      <text x="800" y="0" font-size="46" text-anchor="middle"
            dominant-baseline="central" fill="#d1495b"
            font-family="'Font Awesome 6 Brands'" font-weight="400">&#xf13b;</text>
      <text x="834" y="0" font-size="26" dominant-baseline="central"
            fill="#d1495b" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.html</text>

      <text x="800" y="64" font-size="46" text-anchor="middle"
            dominant-baseline="central" fill="#2B579A"
            font-family="'Font Awesome 6 Free'" font-weight="900">&#xf1c2;</text>
      <text x="834" y="64" font-size="26" dominant-baseline="central"
            fill="#2B579A" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.docx</text>
    </g>
  </g>

</svg>
```
